summary: New sense 1: (Detrans.) ärgerlich, nervös werden, die Fassung verlieren;

data.gloss: (Detrans.) ärgerlich, nervös werden, die Fassung verlieren;

rationale: The entry puts its only example in Detransitive Preterit but has no Detransitive sense list. Makes that inherited emotional-change meaning explicit, confirmed by the new feminine token.

data.turoyo: I žənəke annaqqa mbalhḏo larwal. Ema gʕəbro baqa?
data.translation: Da ging der Frau draußen die Sache auf die Nerven. Wann soll sie endlich hineinkommen?

rationale: Thin Detransitive Preterit; feminine form and self-contained exasperation context, with no expressed stimulus argument.

summary: Feminine mbalhḏo is consistent with the existing Detransitive Preterit masculine mbalhəḏ. The experiencer is the grammatical subject; no external agent is expressed.
Inherited mbalhəḏ aʕli codes the anger target with ʕal-. The new clause omits such a complement; larwal is spatial, not an emotion argument.
The source establishes becoming exasperated while outside, without deciding whether nervousness, anger and losing composure are separate lexical senses. No split or new idiomatic phrase is justified.
Is the ordinary paradigm mbalhaḏle/mbalhəḏ independently used with the same emotion meaning? The supplied textual token only confirms the Detransitive.
Does56/144 convey annoyance or agitation primarily? The broad inherited gloss covers both; no narrower sense is proposed.
